## Root cause (investigated, not yet fixed)

`docker-compose.langfuse.yml:113` pins the Langfuse stack's object store to
`docker.io/minio/minio:latest`. **Docker Hub no longer has a `minio/minio` repository at all**, so
the pull cannot succeed. The job fails at `.github/workflows/external-integration.yml:464-465`
running `docker compose -f docker-compose.langfuse.yml up -d`; the failed log shows
`minio Error pull access denied for minio/minio, repository does not exist or may require
'docker login'`.

Two compounding defects in one line: the image path is stale, **and** it is pinned to floating
`latest` rather than a release tag, which is why this broke silently rather than at a deliberate
upgrade.

### Upstream evidence

- `https://hub.docker.com/v2/repositories/minio/minio/` → `404 {"message":"object not found"}`.
- `https://hub.docker.com/v2/repositories/minio/?page_size=100` → 20 repositories, none named
  `minio`.
- `https://quay.io/api/v1/repository/minio/minio` → public repository, `namespace: minio`,
  `name: minio`, "Multi-Cloud Object Storage", active tag `RELEASE.2025-09-07T16-13-09Z`,
  digest `sha256:14cea493d9a34af32f524e538b8346cf79f3321eff8e708c1e2960462bd8936e`.
- MinIO's own `README.md` on `master` now states the repository is no longer maintained and the
  community edition is source-only; the container image lives on Quay.

### Hypothesis tested empirically

That the failure is the image path itself, not local Docker auth or Compose syntax:

- `docker pull docker.io/minio/minio:latest` → `pull access denied ... repository does not exist`.
- `docker pull quay.io/minio/minio:RELEASE.2025-09-07T16-13-09Z` → **succeeds**, resolving to
  `sha256:14cea493d9a34af32f524e538b8346cf79f3321eff8e708c1e2960462bd8936e`.
- `docker compose -f <copy with the replacement> config --quiet` → validates.

### Proposed fix

Replace with `quay.io/minio/minio:RELEASE.2025-09-07T16-13-09Z`. That matches the file's existing
convention — every other image there is tag-pinned, not floating
(`langfuse-worker:${LANGFUSE_IMAGE_TAG:-3.186.0}`, `clickhouse-server:24.3`, `redis:7`,
`postgres:${POSTGRES_VERSION:-17}`).

### Second occurrence — the fix is incomplete without it

`git grep -F 'docker.io/minio/minio:latest'` finds 2 occurrences:

- `docker-compose.langfuse.yml:113` — the live failing image.
- `docs/experiments/code-review-threshold-calibration-code-v5.md:109` — prose asserting the stale
  pin as current state. It must be reworded to past tense, or the docs keep asserting a defect
  that no longer exists.

### Adjacent gap worth its own ticket

`scripts/check_uv_pin.py:418` globs `**/Dockerfile*` only, so Compose `image:` keys are entirely
unguarded. That is precisely why this stale floating pin survived — the guard that exists to catch
it cannot see Compose files. Filing that separately rather than widening this fix.
